title: Rescue Team of Broom’s Town
overview: When Tanguy the truck bumps into a mooring post at the dock and drives away unaware that his brakes are out, the rescue team tries to intercept him.

title: SchoolB’s Present
overview: SchoolB wants to give balloons to the kids he takes to school. But when the balloons fly away, it's up to the Rescue Team to get them back.

title: Concrete Fuss
overview: Despite Mr. Builder's warnings about the wet concrete, Bruner takes a spill and falls right in. Now, the Rescue Team must find a way to help.

title: New Friends
overview: Cleany takes in a lost cat and the two become fast friends. But when the cat's owner comes calling, Cleany has trouble saying goodbye.

title: Regular Checkup Day
overview: The team learns the importance of regular checkups when Spooky accidentally starts a fire after skipping his appointment with the nurse.

title: Fuss About Ghost
overview: When Cap spreads a rumor about a spooky ghost living in the forest, three kid cars set out to discover if ghosts are real or just pretend.

title: Try Not to Hurry
overview: When the town's streets are blocked for repairs, SchoolB rushes to find an alternate route and learns that being in a hurry can lead to accidents.

title: I Want to Be Praised
overview: Jealous when Poke is praised for digging up a valuable old tire, Bruner sets out to make a find of his own but soon runs into trouble.

title: Trust Your Friends
overview: During a rainstorm, some tires go missing from Wheeler's store. Is there a thief in town, or does the mystery have another explanation?

title: Helly's Birthday
overview: Helly is disappointed when nobody remembers his birthday. Later, Poli and the gang search for a way to make it up to their friend.

title: Where Are You Going, Cleany?
overview: When an out-of-order charging station sends Cleany into overdrive, it's up to the Rescue Team to calm him down before someone gets hurt.

title: Mickey Is Angry!
overview: Mickey can't understand why his friends don't care about guarding the wet concrete. He vows to do it himself but ends up in a sticky situation.

title: I Love You, Grandpa!
overview: When Grandpa Musty gives Mini an old-fashioned spare tire, she worries her friends will make fun of her because the tire isn't exactly cool.

title: It's Okay to Make a Mistake
overview: When Posty spots Spooky making a mistake, he shares the story with his friends. But Posty soon learns that mistakes happen -- even to him.

title: Talent Contest
overview: The gang's getting excited about the town's talent show. When Dump rushes his work so he won't miss the contest, he ends up needing some help.

title: Keep Your Promise
overview: When Annie loses track of her doll, SchoolB promises to help. But finding the doll may be too big a job for SchoolB without some assistance.

title: Please, Cleany!
overview: When too many of his friends ask for his help at once, Cleany tries to make everyone happy. Instead, he winds up in a dangerous situation.

title: Let’s Be Clean!
overview: Spooky wants to break the record for the longest time between baths. But when he's mistaken for a filthy monster, he realizes it's good to be clean.

title: The Friendship Tree
overview: When Cap and Posty get stuck between two trees, they must put their bickering aside and remember why they're best friends in the first place.

title: Remember, Max!
overview: Max's bad memory has everyone worried. When a fire breaks out, it's up to Max to pass along the location to the Rescue Team -- if he can remember it.

title: Hide and Seek
overview: When Mary falls asleep in a pipe that's about to be used in construction, Cleany calls on the Rescue Team to help his friend before it's too late.

title: Beny’s Dream
overview: Beny wants to be a part of the Rescue Team, like his hero, Roy. But when Beny gets a chance to show his stuff, he finds himself in over his head.

title: Escape from the Energy Crisis
overview: When the town's energy runs out, it's up to the Rescue Team to get the lights back on and teach people the importance of conserving.

title: Whose Side Should I Be On?
overview: While playing ball, Posty and Cap get into a feud. Later, the two friends create an awkward situation when they force Cleany to pick a side.

title: Be Healthy
overview: While patrolling the woodlands, Helly hurts his propeller and must rest while the rest of the Rescue Team sets out to save Terry the truck.

title: Our New Friend, Whooper
overview: Whooper the bus comes to town, and everyone warns him about a big storm. But when Whooper doesn't listen, the Rescue Team must save their new friend.
